name: LongMemEval
description: LongMemEval is a benchmark designed to evaluate long-term memory capabilities of chat assistants across five core abilities including information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention, using 500 questions embedded in user-assistant chat histories.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has attracted attention for evaluating long-context and memory behavior in chat assistants, but it is still early in adoption.
notes: Includes a unified framework for memory design and proposes optimizations to improve memory recall and question answering.
